name: @vaipakam/protocol-e2e
description: The protocol's own two-chain Anvil scenarios (#848): the positive flows a forge script cannot drive because they need two chains and moving time — the interaction-reward claim on the canonical chain and on a mirror, the day reports and broadcasts behind it, VPFI moving out and back over the real CCIP token pools, the tier push to a mirror and the guardian pause. Built on the shared two-chain mesh (@vaipakam/anvil-harness/mesh) under a state directory, artifact root and ports of its own. Node-only test tooling; nothing imports it.
